```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 2D: 三组基因交集 Venn 图
# 1. 瘢痕疙瘩内皮差异基因 (scRNA)
# 2. 糖皮质激素/GR 反应基因
# 3. PDT 响应基因 (Bulk GSE84756)
# ============================================================

rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggVennDiagram)

load("stepout/step4output.Rdata")             # Bulk DEG: deg
sc_deg <- readRDS("stepout/SKmarkers_S_vs_K.rds")  # scRNA DEG

# =========================================================================
# 1. 准备三组基因
# =========================================================================

# --- 组1：瘢痕疙瘩内皮差异基因 (scRNA S vs K) ---
group_sc <- sc_deg %>%
  mutate(gene = rownames(.)) %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 1) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

# --- 组2：GR 经典下游 / 糖皮质激素反应基因 ---
# 来源：文献公认的 GR 经典靶基因列表（可根据实际数据库替换）
gr_genes <- c(
  "DUSP1", "GILZ", "TSC22D3", "FKBP5", "CDKN1C", "CXCL8",
  "IL6", "TNF", "ICAM1", "VCAM1", "MKP1", "SGK1", "PDK4",
  "ANGPTL4", "KLF15", "PER1", "ZFP36L1", "NFKBIA", "IER3",
  "ERRFI1", "LPIN1", "PCK1", "G6PC", "PEPCK", "TAT",
  "SLCO2B1", "ZBTB16", "BCL6", "CRISPLD2", "ADORA2B"
)

# --- 组3：PDT 响应基因 (Bulk GSE84756) ---
group_pdt <- deg %>%
  filter(change %in% c("up", "down")) %>%
  pull(symbol) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

cat("scRNA 内皮差异基因数:", length(group_sc), "\n")
cat("GR 反应基因数:",        length(gr_genes),  "\n")
cat("PDT 响应基因数:",       length(group_pdt), "\n")

# =========================================================================
# 2. 计算交集，确认 DUSP1 位置
# =========================================================================

overlap_3 <- Reduce(intersect, list(group_sc, gr_genes, group_pdt))
cat("三组共同交集基因:", paste(overlap_3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("DUSP1 是否在三组交集中:", "DUSP1" %in% overlap_3, "\n")

# 保存交集结果
write.csv(data.frame(Gene = overlap_3), "output/Fig2D_triple_overlap.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================================
# 3-A. 经典三圈 Venn 图（VennDiagram 包，保存为 TIFF）
# =========================================================================

venn_list <- list(
  "scRNA\nEndo DEGs"  = group_sc,
  "GR Response\nGenes" = gr_genes,
  "PDT Response\nGenes" = group_pdt
)

venn.diagram(
  x         = venn_list,
  filename  = "output/Fig2D_Venn_triple.tiff",
  imagetype = "tiff",
  resolution = 300,
  # 三个圆的边框颜色
  col       = c("#9eaad1", "#f5c518", "#f59790"),
  # 三个圆的填充颜色
  fill      = c("#9eaad1", "#f5c518", "#f59790"),
  alpha     = 0.50,
  # 分组标签
  cat.col   = c("#5a6fa0", "#b89010", "#c0392b"),
  cat.cex   = 0.9,
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.dist  = c(0.06, 0.06, 0.04),
  # 数字大小
  cex       = 0.85,
  fontface  = "bold",
  margin    = 0.08,
  scaled    = FALSE,
  disable.logging = TRUE
)

cat("经典 Venn 图已保存至 output/Fig2D_Venn_triple.tiff\n")

# =========================================================================
# 3-B. ggVennDiagram 版本（可导出为 PDF/PNG，更美观）
# =========================================================================

library(ggVennDiagram)

p_venn <- ggVennDiagram(
  x          = venn_list,
  label      = "count",
  label_alpha = 0,
  edge_size  = 0.8
) +
  # 填充色
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7f7f7", high = "#f59790") +
  # 边框色
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#9eaad1", "#d4a017", "#f59790")) +
  # 标注三组交集中的 DUSP1
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0, y = 0,                    # 位置在图中心附近（三圆交集处）
    label = "DUSP1",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    size  = 5,
    color = "#c0392b"
  ) +
  labs(
    title   = "Intersection of scRNA Endo DEGs,\nGR Response Genes & PDT Response Genes",
    caption = paste0(
      "图2D. 瘢痕疙瘩相关内皮细胞差异基因、糖皮质激素/GR 反应相关基因和 PDT 响应基因的交集分析。\n",
      "Venn 图显示 DUSP1 是三类基因集共同包含的候选分子。"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = "gray30"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_venn)

ggsave("output/Fig2D_Venn_triple.pdf", p_venn, width = 7, height = 6)
ggsave("output/Fig2D_Venn_triple.png", p_venn, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# =========================================================================
# 4. 输出各交集详情供核查
# =========================================================================

cat("\n--- 各两两交集 ---\n")
cat("scRNA ∩ GR:", paste(intersect(group_sc, gr_genes), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("scRNA ∩ PDT:", paste(intersect(group_sc, group_pdt), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("GR ∩ PDT:", paste(intersect(gr_genes, group_pdt), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("三组交集:", paste(overlap_3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Figure 2E: DUSP1 高低表达分组的 GR Response Score（基于 GSE84756）
# 方法：ssGSEA 计算 GR 经典靶基因集评分，按 DUSP1 中位数分组比较
# =============================================================================

rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(GSVA)        # ssGSEA，若未安装：BiocManager::install("GSVA")

# ── 1. 载入数据 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load("stepout/step2output.Rdata")   # exp, Group, ids
load("stepout/step4output.Rdata")   # deg

# ── 2. 探针 → 基因符号（取每个基因唯一探针） ─────────────────────────────────
ids_uniq <- ids[!duplicated(ids$symbol), ]
exp_anno <- exp[rownames(exp) %in% ids_uniq$probe_id, ]
rownames(exp_anno) <- ids_uniq$symbol[match(rownames(exp_anno), ids_uniq$probe_id)]

# ── 3. 定义 GR 经典下游靶基因集 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# 参考文献常用的糖皮质激素受体（GR/NR3C1）转录靶基因
gr_gene_set <- list(
  GR_response = c(
    "DUSP1", "GILZ", "TSC22D3", "FKBP5", "ZBTB16", "KLF9",
    "CDKN1C", "SGK1", "ERRFI1", "NFKBIA", "TNFAIP3",
    "PER1", "ANGPTL4", "PDK4", "LGALS1", "DDIT4", "CEBPD",
    "IL6ST", "LIFR", "STAT3", "BCL6", "IRS2", "PCK1"
  )
)

# 只保留在表达矩阵中实际存在的基因
gr_gene_set$GR_response <- intersect(gr_gene_set$GR_response, rownames(exp_anno))
cat("GR 靶基因集中实际可用基因数:", length(gr_gene_set$GR_response), "\n")

# ── 4. ssGSEA 计算 GR response score ─────────────────────────────────────────
# GSVA >= 1.50 用新接口；若报错请改用旧接口（见注释）
gsva_param <- ssgseaParam(exprData = exp_anno, geneSets = gr_gene_set)
gsva_res   <- gsva(gsva_param, verbose = FALSE)
# 旧版写法：gsva_res <- gsva(exp_anno, gr_gene_set, method = "ssgsea", verbose = FALSE)

gr_score <- as.numeric(gsva_res["GR_response", ])

# ── 5. 按 DUSP1 表达量中位数分组 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
dusp1_probes <- ids$probe_id[ids$symbol == "DUSP1"]
dusp1_probes <- intersect(dusp1_probes, rownames(exp))
dusp1_expr   <- colMeans(exp[dusp1_probes, , drop = FALSE])

dusp1_group <- factor(
  ifelse(dusp1_expr >= median(dusp1_expr), "DUSP1-High", "DUSP1-Low"),
  levels = c("DUSP1-Low", "DUSP1-High")
)

# ── 6. 整合数据框 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_df <- data.frame(
  GR_score    = gr_score,
  DUSP1_group = dusp1_group,
  PDT_group   = Group          # Control / PDT
)
cat("\n各分组样本数：\n"); print(table(plot_df$DUSP1_group, plot_df$PDT_group))

# ── 7. 绘图 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_2E <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = DUSP1_group, y = GR_score, fill = DUSP1_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = PDT_group),
    width = 0.15, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DUSP1-Low" = "#9eaad1", "DUSP1-High" = "#f59790")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Control" = "#4a6fa5", "PDT" = "#c0392b"),
    name   = "PDT Status"
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("DUSP1-Low", "DUSP1-High")),
    method      = "wilcox.test",
    label       = "p.signif",
    tip.length  = 0.01,
    size        = 5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "GR Response Score: DUSP1-High vs DUSP1-Low",
    x     = "DUSP1 Expression Group",
    y     = "GR Response Score (ssGSEA)",
    fill  = "DUSP1 Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text       = element_text(color = "black", size = 11)
  )

print(p_2E)

# ── 8. 保存 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("output/Fig2E_GR_score_DUSP1_group.pdf", plot = p_2E, width = 5, height = 5)
ggsave("output/Fig2E_GR_score_DUSP1_group.png", plot = p_2E, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Figure 2F: DUSP1 表达与 PDT Response Score 的关系
# 方法：从 GSE84756 差异分析结果中提取 PDT 响应基因集，
#       ssGSEA 计算评分，双图：① 高低分组箱线图 ② 相关性散点图
# =============================================================================

rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(GSVA)
library(patchwork)

# ── 1. 载入数据 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load("stepout/step2output.Rdata")   # exp, Group, ids
load("stepout/step4output.Rdata")   # deg, logFC_t, P.Value_t

# ── 2. 探针 → 基因符号（唯一映射） ───────────────────────────────────────────
ids_uniq <- ids[!duplicated(ids$symbol), ]
exp_anno <- exp[rownames(exp) %in% ids_uniq$probe_id, ]
rownames(exp_anno) <- ids_uniq$symbol[match(rownames(exp_anno), ids_uniq$probe_id)]

# ── 3. 从差异分析结果构建 PDT 响应基因集 ──────────────────────────────────────
# 使用 adj.P.Val < 0.05 & |logFC| > 1 的显著差异基因
pdt_up   <- deg %>% filter(change == "up")   %>% pull(symbol) %>% unique() %>% na.omit()
pdt_down <- deg %>% filter(change == "down") %>% pull(symbol) %>% unique() %>% na.omit()

gene_sets <- list(
  PDT_Response = intersect(c(pdt_up, pdt_down), rownames(exp_anno))
)
cat("PDT 响应基因集大小 — 上调:", length(intersect(pdt_up, rownames(exp_anno))),
    "| 下调:", length(intersect(pdt_down, rownames(exp_anno))),
    "| 总计:", length(gene_sets$PDT_Response), "\n")

# ── 4. ssGSEA 计算 PDT response score ────────────────────────────────────────
# GSVA >= 1.50 新接口
gsva_param <- ssgseaParam(exprData = exp_anno, geneSets = gene_sets)
gsva_res   <- gsva(gsva_param, verbose = FALSE)
# 旧版写法：gsva_res <- gsva(exp_anno, gene_sets, method = "ssgsea", verbose = FALSE)

pdt_score <- as.numeric(gsva_res["PDT_Response", ])

# ── 5. 提取 DUSP1 表达量并按中位数分组 ───────────────────────────────────────
dusp1_probes <- intersect(ids$probe_id[ids$symbol == "DUSP1"], rownames(exp))
dusp1_expr   <- colMeans(exp[dusp1_probes, , drop = FALSE])

dusp1_group <- factor(
  ifelse(dusp1_expr >= median(dusp1_expr), "DUSP1-High", "DUSP1-Low"),
  levels = c("DUSP1-Low", "DUSP1-High")
)

# ── 6. 整合数据框 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_df <- data.frame(
  DUSP1_expr  = as.numeric(dusp1_expr),
  DUSP1_group = dusp1_group,
  PDT_score   = pdt_score,
  PDT_group   = Group
)

# ── 7A. 箱线图：DUSP1-High vs DUSP1-Low ──────────────────────────────────────
p_box <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = DUSP1_group, y = PDT_score, fill = DUSP1_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = PDT_group),
    width = 0.15, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DUSP1-Low" = "#9eaad1", "DUSP1-High" = "#f59790")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "#4a6fa5", "PDT" = "#c0392b"), name = "PDT Status") +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("DUSP1-Low", "DUSP1-High")),
    method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "PDT Response Score:\nDUSP1-High vs DUSP1-Low",
    x = "DUSP1 Expression Group",
    y = "PDT Response Score (ssGSEA)",
    fill = "DUSP1 Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11)
  )

# ── 7B. 相关性散点图：DUSP1 expression vs PDT response score ─────────────────
p_cor <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = DUSP1_expr, y = PDT_score)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = PDT_group), size = 2.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", se = TRUE,
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, fill = "gray85"
  ) +
  stat_cor(
    method = "spearman",
    label.x.npc = 0.05, label.y.npc = 0.95,
    size = 4.5, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Control" = "#9eaad1", "PDT" = "#f59790"),
    name = "PDT Status"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "DUSP1 Expression vs PDT Response Score",
    x = "DUSP1 Expression Level",
    y = "PDT Response Score (ssGSEA)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11)
  )

# ── 8. 拼图并显示 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_2F <- p_box + p_cor + plot_layout(ncol = 2)
print(p_2F)

# ── 9. 保存 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("output/Fig2F_PDT_score_boxplot.pdf",     plot = p_box, width = 5, height = 5)
ggsave("output/Fig2F_PDT_score_boxplot.png",     plot = p_box, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("output/Fig2F_PDT_score_correlation.pdf", plot = p_cor, width = 5, height = 5)
ggsave("output/Fig2F_PDT_score_correlation.png", plot = p_cor, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("output/Fig2F_combined.pdf",              plot = p_2F,  width = 10, height = 5)
ggsave("output/Fig2F_combined.png",              plot = p_2F,  width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
